about: The postcommunio of the formulary “15th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the working of the heavenly gift, O Lord, so possess us, mind and body, that the action of the sacrament, rather than our senses, may continually prevail in us. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
